== Overview ==

'''UtilityProtocol''' provides a set of general utility functions that can be used between other protocols.

{{Noticebox|''Prior to NEX 3.0.0, this was the [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/StorageManagerProtocol|StorageManagerProtocol]].''}}

== Unique IDs ==

A "unique ID" (also seen as "NEX unique ID") is a globally unique, cryptographically random, value tied to a user. Each user may associate multiple unique IDs to themselves, seemingly with no limit. By default each user has no associated unique IDs. The first unique ID associated with the user is also registered as the users "main" unique ID, and the game server will use it when <code>INVALID_UNIQUEID</code> is provided by the client where one is expected.

Unique IDs can also be optionally secured with a password, which is also cryptographically random.

Each unique ID can only be associated with one user at a time. When a unique ID is secured by a password, that password MUST be sent when associating it with a user. If a unique ID is already associated with a user, and another user tries to associate the same ID with themselves, the operation will fail ''unless'' the user the unique ID is currently associated to is offline. Because offline users are vulnerable to unique ID reassociation, the server MUST ensure that unique ID values and their optional passwords are generated with sufficient entropy to resist guessing and brute-force attacks.

The usage of a unique ID depends on the protocol consuming the ID, though typically they are used in place of a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] when creating data. For example, normally each user may only have a single score per category in [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/RankingProtocol|RankingProtocol]]. However a score can also be created with a unique ID associated with the caller, effectively allowing a user to create multiple scores per category.

When a unique ID is deleted, all data associated with that unique ID on the consuming game server is also deleted. A unique ID is deleted when it becomes unassociated from all users. When calling either [[#AssociateNexUniqueIdWithMyPrincipalId]] or [[#AssociateNexUniqueIdsWithMyPrincipalId]], all unique IDs already associated with the user, except for those also in the input, are unassociated from the caller and are replaced by the unique IDs in the input.

=== AcquireNexUniqueId ===

Creates a new [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] associated with the caller. This [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] is NOT password protected.

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt64 || pNexUniqueId || [[#Unique IDs]]
|}

=== AcquireNexUniqueIdWithPassword ===

Creates a new [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] associated with the caller. This [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] is password protected.

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#UniqueIdInfo]] || pNexUniqueIdInfo || [[#Unique IDs|Unique ID]] and password
|}

=== AssociateNexUniqueIdWithMyPrincipalId ===

Associates the provided [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] with the caller and assigns it as the callers "main" ID. All other [[#Unique IDs]] are unassociated from the caller.

If the [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] is not valid, <code>RendezVous::InvalidUniqueId</code> is thrown.

If the [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] is password protected and the password does not match, <code>RendezVous::InvalidPassword</code> is thrown.

If the [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] is associated with another user already and that user is still online, an error is thrown.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#UniqueIdInfo]] || uniqueIdInfo || [[#Unique IDs|Unique ID]] to associate with the caller
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== AssociateNexUniqueIdsWithMyPrincipalId ===

Associates multiple [[#Unique IDs]] with the caller. The first entry is assigned as the callers "main" ID. All other [[#Unique IDs]] are unassociated from the caller.

If a [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] is not valid, <code>RendezVous::InvalidUniqueId</code> is thrown.

If a [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] is password protected and the password does not match, <code>RendezVous::InvalidPassword</code> is thrown.

If a [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]] is associated with another user already and that user is still online, an error is thrown.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#UniqueIdInfo]]&gt; || uniqueIdInfo || [[#Unique IDs]] to associate with the caller
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== GetAssociatedNexUniqueIdWithMyPrincipalId ===

Returns the callers "main" [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]].

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#UniqueIdInfo]] || pUniqueIdInfo || The callers "main" [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]]
|}

=== GetAssociatedNexUniqueIdsWithMyPrincipalId ===

Returns all the callers associated [[#Unique IDs]]. The first entry is the callers "main" [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]]

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#UniqueIdInfo]]&gt; || pUniqueIdInfo || All the callers [[#Unique IDs]]
|}

=== GetIntegerSettings ===

Returns game-specific integer settings. Each game server can configure different settings for different indexes, and the values are game-specific.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || integerSettingIndex || Which settings to return
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#Map|Map]]&lt;UInt32, SInt32&gt; || integerSettings || Settings
|}

=== GetStringSettings ===

Returns game-specific [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#String|String]] settings. Each game server can configure different settings for different indexes, and the values are game-specific.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || stringSettingIndex || Which settings to return
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#Map|Map]]&lt;UInt32, [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#String|String]]&gt; || stringSettings || Settings
|}

=== UniqueIdInfo ===

Information about a specific [[#Unique IDs]] entry.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt64 || nexUniqueId || [[#Unique IDs]]. Can be <code>INVALID_UNIQUEID</code> if a value is not set
|-
| UInt64 || nexUniqueIdPassword || The password for the unique ID. 0 if not password protected
|}

{| class="wikitable"
! Name !! Type !! Value !! Description
|-
| <code>INVALID_UNIQUEID</code> || UInt64 || 0 || Invalid [[#Unique IDs|unique ID]]. This is used when either in "zeroed" data or when a value is not needed
|}
